{{Quote|We have our battleships. We have our droids. If Palpatine wants our wealth, let him come and take it.|Customs Vizier Marath Vooro, challenging the Galactic Empire|<ref name="News" />}}
The '''Five Veils Campaign''' was an campaign launched in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]], against the [[Trade Federation resistance|renegade]] members of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Led by [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]], portions of the company refused to acknowledge the [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|treaty]] that gave the Empire control of the Federation's resources and assets. In response, Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] [[Battle of Farstine|smashed]] Vooro's forces at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farstine]], before [[Battle of the Hook Nebula|capturing]] Vooro in the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]], ending the campaign.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Where is Gunray? Where is Haako? A third-tier flunky has no right to negotiate on the Trade Federation's behalf.|Customs Vizier Marath Vooro, on Sentepeth Findos's signing of the treaty|<ref name="News" />}}
After the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] saw the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] defeat the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], some parts of the Confederacy-allied [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] company continued to [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|resist]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The resistance, which was led by the Trade Federation's [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]], refused to acknowledge the [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|treaty]] signed by Acting [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Sentepeth Findos]], which gave control of all of the company's resources and assets to the Empire.<ref name="Warfare" />

Vooro, who declared that Findos' authority to make decisions for the Trade Federation was illegitimate,<ref name="News" /> led the [[Trade Federation resistance|resisting]] portions of the company from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]]. There he retained a force of [[Trade Federation fleet/Legends|Trade Federation Defense Fleet]]<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], challenging the Empire to come and take the Federation's wealth.<ref name="News" /> The Empire responded by dispatching [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] to deal with them during their [[Reconquest of the Rim]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==The campaign==
Vooro's campaign was hampered by a lack of effective [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. Consequently, Grant's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Battle of Farstine|decisively defeated]] Vooro's forces at the world of [[Farstine]], before chasing Vooro down the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]]. Grant finally [[Battle of the Hook Nebula|captured]] Vooro on the fringes of the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], ending the campaign.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Aftermath==
With the resistance eliminated and Vooro captured,<ref name="Warfare" /> the Trade Federation military power ceased to exist.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|257&ndash;258|Trade Federation}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Five Veils Campaign was first mentioned in the article ''[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]], and released in [[2005]] in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|84th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="News" /> In [[2012]], the campaign was identified and expanded on in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
